name: Field Lock & Hide Mechanisms (four distinct forms)
description: Four different ways a field is made non-editable or invisible, all present on one page. They are not interchangeable — each sits at a different level of the tree and has different semantics. Choosing the wrong one is a common source of fields that look locked but still accept input, or that vanish when they should merely grey out.

1_pageWideReadOnly.effect: Entire page becomes non-interactive in view mode.
1_pageWideReadOnly.rule: Declare this ONCE at the page root. Do not re-check page mode on individual controls — the only exception is hiding action buttons (add/delete), which use mechanism 4 so they disappear rather than merely freeze.

2_hardcodedDisabled.effect: Never editable, in any mode. Observed on Doc# and Exchange Rate, and on every computed numeric cell in the line-items grid.
2_hardcodedDisabled.rule: Use for values the user may never type. For values that are ALWAYS computed and never contextually editable, prefer atom.numeric-label (dxnumlbl) over a disabled dxnumberbox.

3_conditionalLock.level: field wrapper sect, OR the inner entryValueDiv
3_conditionalLock.effect: Field stays visible but frozen, based on configuration or on another field's value.
3_conditionalLock.rule: Placing it on the wrapper sect freezes label and value together; placing it on entryValueDiv leaves the label selectable. Watch the polarity — the Supplier field INVERTS iftrue/iffalse because it enables rather than disables.

4_conditionalHide.effect: Subtree removed entirely. Works at whole-section, single-field-pair, and single-button granularity.
4_conditionalHide.rule: Children render when xsUp is FALSY. To show a block only when a value IS configured, use the coalesce-then-compare idiom: [dsDocumentMaster.DM_PREVIOUS_DOCTYPE(ifnull)raw.(eq)raw.] — i.e. hide when it equals empty.

observedFlags.dsDocumentMaster.DM_PREVIOUS_DOCTYPE: show the fetch-previous-document bar when set
observedFlags.dsDocumentMaster.HIDE_VAT: hide the VAT Amount summary row
observedFlags.DsFrmHeaderEntry.ACMST_SUBLEDGER_EXISTS: enable Supplier only when the chosen GL account has sub-ledgers

rules: resolvestyles:true is mandatory wherever a bracket expression appears inside style/appendprops.style — without it the expression renders as a literal string and the field silently stays editable.
Static props go in `props`; anything with an expression goes in `appendprops`.
`required:true` is NOT a lock and NOT enforcement — validation in this engine is action-based (action.validatedataset). A control can carry required:true and still save empty.
